blocks.text: Vectors woh physical quantities hain jinhen poori tarah batane ke liye magnitude (size) ke saath direction (simt) bhi batani parti hai.

items: Displacement: kisi cheez ki position (jagah) mein change. Is mein length, yani distance (magnitude), aur ek direction hoti hai (example: 10 m west (maghrib) ki taraf).
Velocity: kisi khaas direction mein cheez ki speed (example: 50 km h⁻¹ west ki taraf).
Acceleration: velocity badalne ka rate; velocity speed mein badle, direction mein ya dono mein (example: 10 m s⁻² oopar ki taraf).
Force: kisi cheez par push (dhakka) ya pull (kheenchna), jo apni magnitude aur direction se tay hoti hai (example: 20 N right (daen) taraf).

blocks.text: Graphical Representation of a Vector (vector ko drawing se dikhana)

Vector quantity dikhane ka achha tareeqa vector diagram hai, jis mein vectors ko arrow (teer) se dikhaya jata hai. Arrow ki length magnitude batati hai aur arrow ka head (sira) direction batata hai. Kitab mein vectors bold (mote) letters se likhe jate hain (jaise V, F) ya letter ke oopar arrow bana kar (A⃗).
Rectangular Components of a Vector (vector ke rectangular components)

Kisi vector ka component (hissa) us ki effective value (asal asar) hai kisi di gayi direction mein. Ek vector ko kuch specified (tay shuda) directions mein apne component vectors ka resultant (sab mil kar banne wala vector) samjha ja sakta hai. Aam taur par vector ko aisi do directions mein resolve karte (torte) hain jo ek doosre par perpendicular (90° par) hon. Aise components rectangular components kehlate hain.

Farz karein vector A⃗ ko line OP se dikhaya gaya hai jo x-axis ke saath angle θ banati hai. A⃗ ka x-axis par projection (saya) OM aur y-axis par projection ON banayein (Fig. 2.1). x-direction wala projection OM, A⃗x kehlata hai aur y-direction wala projection ON, A⃗y. Head to tail rule (ek vector ka head doosre ki tail se jorna) lagane se:

blocks.alt: X aur Y axes O par milte hain. Vector A, O se P tak x-axis se angle theta par hai. Us ka component Ax x-axis par O se M tak aur component Ay y-axis par O se N tak hai; dashed (toti hui) lines N ko P se aur P ko M se jorti hain.

Determination of a Vector from its Rectangular Components (components se vector maloom karna)
Agar kisi vector ke rectangular components diye hon (Fig. 2.1), to Pythagorean theorem se vector ki magnitude nikal sakte hain.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Component nikalna: Ax = A cos θ aur Ay = A sin θ. Wapas vector banana: magnitude A = √(Ax² + Ay²) aur direction θ = tan⁻¹(Ay/Ax). Example: 20 N ki force 60° par ho to Fx = 20 cos 60° = 10 N aur Fy = 20 sin 60° = 17.3 N.

blocks.title: Example 2.1
blocks.problem: Barabar magnitude wali do forces ke darmiyan angle nikalein jab un ke resultant ki magnitude bhi har ek force ke barabar ho.
steps:
Farz karein F₁ aur F₂ ke darmiyan angle θ hai aur F₁ x-axis ke saath hai. Resultant ka x-component:
Rx = F₁ cos 0° + F₂ cos θ
Rx = F₁ + F₂ cos θ (kyun ke cos 0° = 1)

Resultant ka y-component:
Ry = F₁ sin 0° + F₂ sin θ
Ry = F₂ sin θ (kyun ke sin 0° = 0)
Question ke mutabiq R = F₁ = F₂ = F

Is liye F² = (F + F cos θ)² + (F sin θ)²
F² = F² + F²cos²θ + 2F² cos θ + F² sin²θ
Dono taraf se F² kat jata hai: 0 = 2F² cos θ + F² (cos²θ + sin²θ)
cos²θ + sin²θ = 1, is liye 0 = 2F² cos θ + F²
F² se divide (taqseem) karein: cos θ = -0.5
blocks.answer: θ = cos⁻¹(-0.5) = 120°. Yani do barabar forces 120° par hon to un ka resultant bhi utna hi hota hai.

blocks.prompt: 20 N ki force horizontal (leti hui seedhi line) se 60° oopar lagti hai. Is ke rectangular components nikalein, phir un se wapas magnitude aur direction nikal kar dekhein.

items: Vector: magnitude aur direction dono (displacement, velocity, acceleration, force); arrow se dikhate hain, bold letter ya letter par arrow se likhte hain.
Rectangular components: A⃗ = A⃗x + A⃗y, Ax = A cos θ, Ay = A sin θ; wapas: A = √(Ax² + Ay²), θ = tan⁻¹(Ay/Ax).
Example 2.1: do barabar forces ka resultant bhi utna hi ho to un ke darmiyan angle 120° hai.
